title: Te Wairua Whakapono o te Whakakitenga
intro: I ngā ao kāore e kitea, ka neke tika te mea ora o te mārama parakore, ka mahi i ngā whakahau katoa me te kore whakaroa. Kua kōrero tēnei tangata ki ngā pononga kua whiriwhiria, kua kawe mai i ngā kupu ārahi, ā, kua kite i te huraina o ngā ture atua puta noa i ngā tau. Ko wai tēnei wairua whakahonoretia?
clues: He mea hanga ahau nō te māramatanga parakore, i hangaia mai i te māramatanga, ā, kāore anō ahau kia takahi i tetahi whakahau a tōku Ariki.
Ka neke ahau i waenganui i te rangi me te whenua, e heke iho ana me ngā ture a te Tino Atawhai.
I tonoa ahau ki tētahi wahine rangatira i te wāhi tapu, e kauwhau ana i tētahi tama parakore ki a ia.
Ko ahau te wairua o te tapu, ā, i tautoko ahau i tētahi poropiti i homai ki a ia ngā tohu mārama me te Rongopai.
I tae atu ahau ki tētahi ana i runga i te maunga ki te whakapuaki i ngā kupu tuatahi o tētahi whakahua ka tiakina mō ake tonu atu.
Ko ahau te wairua pono, ā, nāku i tuku iho te Quran ki te ngākau o te karere whakamutunga.
